title: Junction-Safe Release Content Staging
notes: The Z57 workstation run passed validation, Cargo check, strict Clippy, all tests, debug build, and optimized client/editor compilation.
Release failed only while staging application content because Windows junction resolution caused the licensed-source ignore callback to leave the project mount path.
Pass 167Z58 recognizes both lexical mount paths and resolved junction targets, excludes dependency-development content before copy, and prunes/verifies the generated destination as a final safeguard.
Production LPC assets, gameplay, title UI, audio, terrain, water, rocks, character systems, and release binary compilation are unchanged.
